aboutUs.heading: The Keepers
aboutUs.subheading: The collectors, designers, and technologists behind Perfumer's Hollow.

content.subheading: Two collectors chasing the scent of something rare
content.one: Late at night, long after the city quiets down, you’ll usually find us surrounded by perfume bottles, scattered notes, and conversations about fragrances we still can’t stop thinking about.
content.two: We’re Brian and Amanda — the husband-and-wife team behind Perfumer’s Hollow.
content.three: What began as a personal way to track our growing collection slowly became something larger. One bottle led to another, notes turned into records, and over time those records became the foundation for the Archive you see today.
content.four: Perfumer’s Hollow was built from a shared belief that fragrance is more than luxury. Every scent carries atmosphere, memory, emotion, and story — and the people who collect perfume understand that better than anyone.
content.five: The platform continues to grow one fragrance, one house, and one collector at a time. Every review adds perspective. Every wishlist sparks discovery. Every exchange helps keep perfume culture alive and moving forward.
content.six: We created this space for the curious — the collectors, romantics, archivists, and late-night explorers who know that sometimes a single note can stay with you for years.
content.seven: And if something is missing from the Archive, let us know. We’re always searching for the next great discovery.
content.eight: So step in from the rain, stay awhile, and explore the Hollow with us.

meta.title: The Collector’s Guide - perfumer's hollow
meta.description: Learn how perfumer's hollow works.

howItWorks.heading: The Game of Bottles and Trust
howItWorks.subheading: Your guide to the Archive and Exchange.

section1.title: Step One: Light Your Match — Create an Account
section1.content: Creating an account opens the door to Perfumer’s Hollow — a hidden network where collectors, archivists, and fragrance enthusiasts gather to explore, review, trade, and document the scents worth remembering.
section1.content2: Visitors may still wander the Archive freely, but participation belongs to those who choose to step deeper into the Hollow.
section1.content3: The first 100 memberships are complimentary — a quiet acknowledgment of the early collectors who discovered the Hollow before the lights came on.
section1.content4: And your information remains yours. Never sold. Never traded. Never shared beyond the Hollow.

section2.title: Step Two: List Your Decants — Share the Scent
section2.content: Some fragrances are too good to remain undiscovered.
section2.content2: Listing your decants allows other collectors to experience the bottles that shaped your journey — from rare finds and discontinued favorites to everyday signatures worth revisiting.
section2.content3: Describe the fragrance, document its character, and share what made it memorable to you. Every listing adds something new to the Archive and helps fellow collectors uncover scents they may never have encountered otherwise.
section2.content4: Perfumer’s Hollow provides the space for these exchanges to happen openly and transparently. While we do not handle trades or payments directly, we help collectors connect through a trusted and community-driven platform.

section3.title: Step Three: Build Your Wishlist — Chase the One That Got Away
section3.content: Every collector remembers certain fragrances — the discontinued favorite, the impossible-to-find bottle, the scent that never fully left memory.
section3.content2: Your wishlist keeps those discoveries close.
section3.content3: Save the fragrances you’ve been searching for and receive notifications when they appear within the Hollow. Over time, your wishlist becomes more than a collection of bottles — it becomes a record of personal taste, memories, and the scents still waiting to be rediscovered.

section4.title: Step Four: Make the Trade — The Quiet Exchange
section4.content2: When collectors connect through the Hollow, they arrange trades directly — discussing details, making offers, and building trust through a shared appreciation for fragrance.
section4.content3: Perfumer’s Hollow does not process transactions or handle payments. We simply provide the platform where collectors can connect, communicate, and arrange exchanges transparently.
section4.content4: What happens next belongs entirely to the collectors involved.

section5.title: The Sillage We Leave Behind
section5.content: Perfumer’s Hollow exists for collectors who understand that fragrance is never just fragrance.
section5.content2: It is memory. Atmosphere. Discovery. A fleeting moment that somehow stays with you long after it disappears.
section5.content3: Every review, exchange, and saved bottle adds another layer to the growing Archive and the community shaping it.
section5.content4: We value curiosity over trends, privacy over noise, and genuine passion over performance.
section5.content5: In the end, the fragrance fades. What remains is the connection it created.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How do I add a missing perfume or perfume house?
faq.answer1: If you notice a perfume or perfume house missing from our database, you can submit it using the buttons below. Your submission will be reviewed by an admin before being added to the database. We're always looking to expand our collection and appreciate your help in making perfumer's hollow more complete.
faq.question2: How does the trading system work?
faq.answer2: perfumer's hollow provides a platform for collectors to connect and trade. We don't handle transactions or payments directly — those are arranged between you and your trading partner. We simply provide the space and tools to make those connections happen safely and transparently.
faq.answer3: Absolutely. We take privacy seriously. We don't sell, trade, or share your personal information. Your data stays yours, and what happens in the shadows stays there.
faq.question4: How do I create an account?
faq.answer4: Creating an account is free and easy. Simply click the 'Sign In' button in the navigation, then choose 'Sign Up' to create your account. Accounts are free for the first 100 members, and we keep it that way to honor our early supporters.
faq.question5: Can I review perfumes without an account?
faq.answer5: You can browse and search the site without an account, but to rate, review, list decants, or build your wishlist, you'll need to create an account. It's free and gives you access to the full perfumer's hollow experience.
faq.question6: What if I find an error in the database?
faq.answer6: We appreciate your attention to detail! If you spot an error — whether it's a misspelling, incorrect information, or a duplicate entry — please let us know via email. We'll review it and make corrections as needed.

meta.title: Community Policy - perfumer's hollow
meta.description: Shipping expectations, dispute process, and community rules for traders.

shipping.heading: Shipping expectations
shipping.contentOne: All payment and shipping are arranged off-platform between traders. Agree on carriers, packaging, and timelines in your messages before anyone ships.
shipping.contentTwo: Ship within a reasonable window after both sides confirm the trade (typically within one week unless you agree otherwise). Share tracking when available.
shipping.contentThree: Package bottles securely: use padding, seal decants, and disclose any known flaws before shipping.

disputes.heading: Dispute process
disputes.contentOne: If something goes wrong, message the other trader first and try to resolve it directly.
disputes.contentTwo: If you cannot resolve the issue, use Open dispute on the active trade card, or Report on their trader profile for off-trade issues. Include photos and a clear description.
disputes.contentThree: Our team reviews reports and may issue strikes or account actions. We do not hold funds or guarantee refunds — we help document disputes and enforce community rules.

community.heading: Community rules
community.contentOne: Be honest about bottle condition, volume remaining, and authenticity. Listings should include accurate photos.
community.contentTwo: Harassment, scams, and no-ship behavior are not tolerated. Repeated issues affect reputation and may lead to suspension.
community.contentThree: Leave feedback only after a completed trade so reviews reflect real exchanges.

offPlatform.heading: Off-platform payments
offPlatform.contentOne: perfumer's hollow connects traders; we never process payments or shipping labels.
offPlatform.contentTwo: Use payment methods you trust, keep message records on-platform when possible, and never share passwords or unrelated financial details.

meta.title: Terms and Conditions - perfumer's hollow
meta.description: Terms of use, trading rules, and privacy policy for perfumer's hollow.

gist.heading: THE GIST
gist.contentOne: perfumer's hollow is an independent platform devoted to perfume lovers — a place to share reviews, learn, and connect with other collectors. Users may list perfumes and samples for trade, but the dealings themselves are strictly between private individuals.
gist.contentTwo: We do not handle payments, do not verify authenticity, and will not mediate disputes. Think of us as the smoke-filled bar where introductions are made, not the broker of the deal.

tradingAndListing.heading: TRADING AND LISTING
tradingAndListing.contentOne: Trades and exchanges are entirely at your own risk.
tradingAndListing.contentThree: Split (decanted) perfumes are permitted, provided they are genuine and accurately described.
tradingAndListing.contentFour: Any attempt to defraud, misrepresent, or sell stolen goods will result in permanent account removal and possible reporting to relevant authorities.
tradingAndListing.contentFive: Users must describe items truthfully — if you’re listing a vintage bottle, say so; if the label’s half gone, that’s part of its story.

accountsAndConduct.heading: ACCOUNTS AND USER CONDUCT
accountsAndConduct.contentOne: You’ll need an account to post reviews, notes, or trades. Browsing and searching are open to everyone.
accountsAndConduct.contentTwo: Keep it civil: no harassment, spam, political or religious debates, or illegal content.
accountsAndConduct.contentThree: This is a perfume community, not a soapbox or battleground. Treat others with the respect you’d show in a high-end fragrance boutique.

reviewsAndNotes.heading: REVIEWS AND NOTES
reviewsAndNotes.contentOne: Users may submit perfume reviews or leave notes on discussions to help others navigate their scent journeys.
reviewsAndNotes.contentTwo: All content goes through a moderation process to ensure it’s relevant, fair, and on-topic. We reserve the right to remove or edit submissions that break these rules or drift into unrelated territory.
reviewsAndNotes.contentThree: By posting, you grant perfumer's hollow the non-exclusive right to display your words and images on the site and in related features (such as listings or community highlights). You retain full ownership of your work.

noGuarantee.heading: NO GUARANTEES
noGuarantee.contentOne: We strive to keep the site polished and running, but we make no promises of uninterrupted service. We may suspend, modify, or remove features without warning — sometimes even good things must fade to make room for the new.

liability.heading: LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
liability.contentOne: perfumer's hollow and its operators are not responsible for any loss, damage, or dispute arising from user trades, communications, or listings.
liability.contentTwo: If a deal goes sour, it’s between the parties involved. The platform merely sets the stage — the drama belongs to you.

privacy.heading: PRIVACY POLICY
privacy.contentOne: We respect your privacy as much as a perfumer guards a secret formula. Here’s how we handle your data:

contentList.one: Information Collected: We may collect basic account information (such as username, email, and preferences) to help personalize your experience and improve the site.
contentList.two: Use of Data: Data is used internally only — for recommendations, feature improvements, and fraud prevention. It is never sold, never shared with advertisers, and never used for resale or marketing beyond this site.
contentList.three: Cookies: Like many websites, we use cookies to remember your session and keep you logged in.
contentList.four: Security: We take reasonable steps to protect your data, but no system is impenetrable. Handle your account credentials as carefully as you’d handle your favorite perfume bottle.
contentList.five: Contact: For questions, data requests, or to report suspicious activity, reach us at [INSERT CONTACT EMAIL HERE].

changes.heading: CHANGES TO THIS POLICY
changes.contentOne: We may revise these Terms and this Privacy Policy from time to time. Updates will be posted on this page with a new “last updated” date. Continuing to use the site after changes means you accept them — the way one accepts that the night always carries a hint of mystery.

closing.heading: CLOSING WORDS
closing.contentOne: perfumer's hollow exists to celebrate the art, science, and stories behind scent. Use it wisely, trade fairly, and remember — trust your nose, not a stranger’s promises.
